entities.summary: The Lorzadeh Mosque, sometimes spelled as the Lor Zadeh Mosque, is a mosque located on Lorzadeh Street in the city of Tehran, in the province of Tehran, Iran. The mosque was completed in c. 1940s CE, during the 14th century SH.
